learner_words: I got to space! The rocket went all the way!
guide_note: Friday after lunch, Pip was in a great mood. Rhyme Rocket was clearly the right note to end the week on — she lit up when the rocket launched animations played. Got 16 of 18 and completed level 3, which is the first time she has finished a full level this week. One slip where she picked a word that started the same instead of one that rhymed, but she self-corrected on a similar question later, so I think it is sinking in. She was much less hesitant than Monday. Pip asked if we can do dinosaurs again next week, which I am taking as a good sign.
